title: George is Rettie, Willing, and Able
author: Dean Snipes
problems: Row 2 "pass through across the set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 4 "star right 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "robins allemande left once around while the larks orbit clockwise ½ around" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 5 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 8 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
The progression after row 5 "neighbors pull by right up and down" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
The progression after row 9 "robins pull by right" doesn't work out: Couples 2 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
